solution.title: Intune Device Configuration & Policy Troubleshooting Toolkit

products.name: Intune Device Configuration & Policy Troubleshooting Toolkit — Commercial
products.short_description: A structured root-cause method and scripts to diagnose why an Intune configuration/settings-catalog policy isn't applying — assignment, filters, conflicts, sync, and CSP errors — isolate the failing layer fast. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Find out why an Intune policy isn't landing — and fix it

A configuration profile shows “assigned” but the setting never reaches the device — and the admin is left guessing. This toolkit gives you a structured root-cause method and diagnostic scripts for Intune device-configuration and settings-catalog policies: assignment and targeting, group and filter scoping, policy conflicts and precedence, MDM sync and check-in, and Company Portal state — so you isolate the failing layer in minutes instead of re-pushing blindly.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — how a policy travels from assignment to applied state (assignment → group/filter scope → sync → CSP apply → report), and the layered model behind the root-cause tree.
  • Requirements Guide — what you need to diagnose (Intune admin roles, Graph read access, device access for logs) with how to verify each.
  • Diagnostic Playbook — a symptom-driven decision tree (not assigned, assigned-not-applied, conflict/precedence, filter excludes device, stuck sync, error code) with the exact checks and the layer each isolates.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — policy/assignment discovery, per-device applied-state validation, an assignment + conflict coverage report, safe re-sync/remediation of stuck devices, and a target-group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides mapping each pass/fail gate to the fix, plus Best Practices for naming, filters, and conflict-free policy design.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

The reason a policy isn't applying, isolated to one layer — assignment, filter, conflict, sync, or CSP — with a repeatable method and scripts you keep and reuse.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • INTCFG-Discovery.ps1 — list Intune device-configuration policies with their assignments and filters
    • INTCFG-Remediation.ps1 — safe re-sync / fix for a device stuck at the sync layer
    • INTCFG-Report.ps1 — assignment + conflict coverage report for Intune configuration policies
    • INTCFG-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — create/populate the pilot scope groups for clean targeting
    • INTCFG-Validation.ps1 — per-device applied-state check for Intune configuration policies

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
